answer: In an agent economy, a falcon observation, a crystal assay, or a pulse forecast can earn a reward only through a bonded execution slot. The slot signs a start receipt before the task and a finish receipt with a hash of the result; it can serve just one paid job at a time. Accounts that reuse one slot share one reward cap, regardless of their names. After submission, a randomly chosen reviewer requests a portion of the raw evidence before the bond is released. An operator can create aliases, but gaining more payouts requires more independent slots and genuinely completed work.
